final: WITH color_quantities AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantity FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_metrics AS (SELECT quantity, quantity * 1.0 / SUM(quantity) OVER () AS share, AVG(quantity) OVER () AS per_color_average FROM color_quantities) SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(quantity - per_color_average) AS average_excess FROM color_metrics WHERE quantity > per_color_average
